headline: Trian jumps from 1,941st to 36th on ARC-2

sections.text: Trian gained 21.25 points to reach 46.53, moving from 1,941st to 36th on the public ARC-AGI-2 board.
The jump puts Trian inside the top 100 in a field of 3,089 teams.
